items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: I think Gill was his last name, I’m not sure. ... Vince Gill and then that new young girl, Leann Rimes? She’s a fabulous singer, got a great voice and she’s just true blue, you know right in there. It’s the kind of stuff you like to hear.

ctx.x: I remembered his name because I was so struck by this wonderful music. Great harmony. Great players.
I think Gill was his last name, I’m not sure.
His last name was Gill? © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
